title: Optimal Experimental Design for Staggered Rollouts
eligible_reason: Methodological paper on designing staggered-rollout experiments. The package contains Python notebooks that solve optimal designs and run synthetic experiments on empirical panels (flu, loan, grocery, medical data matrices) with simulated treatment assignments; there is no observational DiD estimate of a real treatment and no regression command list (0 regressions extracted).
design_notes: Package replication_package_MS-DSC-22-00071: README.md, code/*.ipynb and utils_*.py (within transformation, OLS/GLS, design solvers, adaptive algorithm), data/flu.csv loan.csv grocery.csv medical.csv home_medical.csv (preprocessed outcome matrices), result/*.pkl.
screener_notes: Out of scope: no empirical treatment effect estimated.
